concerns.text: US-1 (Data Ingestion and Descriptor Engineering, P1) is backed by FR-001 but has NO success criterion. SC-001–SC-003 anchor to US-2/US-3; SC-004 anchors to FR-006. The foundational data pipeline story has no measurable outcome (e.g., dataset completeness/quality measured against the NIST source). Add an SC anchored to US-1.

FR-006 ('hard timeout of 6 hours for the entire CI job') cites '(See Assumption: Compute Feasibility)' — an assumption, not a user story. No user story's scope covers whole-pipeline CI resource limits (the Edge Cases section mentions RAM/OOM but is not a story). Re-anchor FR-006 to a story (e.g., extend US-2 or add a compute-feasibility story) or remove it.
SC-004 traces to FR-006, which itself has no user-story anchor, so SC-004 is transitively unanchored to any story. Once FR-006 is re-anchored, update SC-004's traceability accordingly.

FR-006 cites '(See Assumption: Compute Feasibility)' but the Assumptions section names that assumption 'Computational Constraints'. The cross-reference label does not resolve to any section by that name — rename one or the other.

Feature Branch is '001-gene-regulation', which is unrelated to this project's topic (hydrogen diffusion in metals). Likely a copy-paste leftover from another project; should be e.g. '001-hydrogen-diffusion-prediction'.

Terminology drift for the same concept: US-1 and FR-001 use 'free_volume_proxy' / 'free volume', while the Edge Cases section says 'specific microstructural parameters (e.g., `free_volume`)'. Pick one stable name for the derived proxy.

'the output dataframe contains at least 50% more columns than the input' is a pre-asserted empirical threshold inconsistent with the spec's own stated convention (SC preamble: defer specific percentages to the research phase) and with the [deferred] markers used elsewhere (e.g., FR-003). State the column-set requirement qualitatively or defer the ratio.

Then the output dataframe contains at least 50% more columns than the input" — this threshold is arbitrary and unanchored to any FR or scientific need; it is measurable but meaningless as a pass/fail bar (adding junk columns would pass). Replace with a check that the specific named descriptor columns (mean_electronegativity, atomic_radius_variance, free_volume_proxy, etc.) exist and are non-null, which the Independent Test already states correctly.

the system gracefully stops the search and reports the best model found so far rather than crashing or hanging' is only vaguely verifiable. State the observable evidence, e.g., 'the search loop exits within [a bounded grace period] of the 2-hour budget and the output log contains the best hyperparameters and CV score found so far, with exit code 0' — the log-content check in the Independent Test is the right form; mirror it here.

Under-reach: the idea's methodology explicitly includes an 'Independence Check' — 'Ensure the validation target (experimental D) is derived from independent measurements (e.g., permeation experiments) distinct from the input descriptors... avoiding circular validation.' No FR or acceptance scenario in the spec addresses descriptor/target source separation or leakage prevention. This is also mandated by Constitution Principle VII (Independent Validation and Descriptor Provenance). Add an FR requiring documented separation of descriptor provenance from the validation target, and that k-NN imputation not use the target variable.

The idea's preprocessing specifies 'normalize all numerical features using StandardScaler'; the spec only covers unit harmonization of diffusion coefficients (US-1 SC-3) and omits feature scaling. Confirm this is intentional or add it to FR-001 to avoid silent narrowing of the stated preprocessing pipeline.

Temperature is absent from the entire feature set. Hydrogen diffusivity in metals is Arrhenius-governed and varies by many orders of magnitude with T; any model of D without temperature (or activation energy) as a predictor conflates composition effects with measurement-temperature effects. The related-work citation (non-Arrhenian diffusion) makes this central. The spec must either include measurement temperature as a descriptor or restrict to isothermal comparisons.

RMSE and R² are specified on raw diffusion coefficients. D spans ~10 orders of magnitude across metals, so raw-scale RMSE is dominated by high-D materials and R² is near-meaningless. Standard practice is regression on log10(D). The spec must state the target transform; otherwise the linear-vs-non-linear comparison (SC-001) is not a valid test of the research question.

concerns.location: spec.md:FR-001 (k-NN imputation) vs FR-002/FR-003 (CV, held-out test)
concerns.text: Imputation (and StandardScaler normalization) is specified as a pipeline step before model training, but nothing requires it to be fit on training folds only. k-NN imputation fit on the full dataset leaks test-set information into training. Add an explicit requirement that imputation/scaling are nested inside the CV folds and fit on the held-out test set only via the fitted pipeline.

Hyperparameters are tuned via Bayesian optimization and then models are compared on a single held-out test set, with the linear baseline presumably untuned. With ~200 samples and many descriptors this comparison is biased toward the tuned non-linear models. Nested cross-validation (outer folds for evaluation, inner for tuning) is the accepted design for this claim; the spec should require it or justify the single split.

SC-003 measures interaction contribution 'relative to the total variance' via SHAP interaction values. SHAP values decompose the MODEL's output, not the variance of the experimental target — a well-overfit model can have large SHAP interactions that explain nothing about D. As written, SC-003 can be satisfied by model artifacts, not physics. Tie the interaction claim to generalization performance (e.g., held-out R² degradation when the term is ablated, as US-3.3 hints) rather than SHAP magnitude alone.

Microstructural proxies are 'derived from processing parameters and literature-derived correlations.' If those literature correlations were themselves calibrated against diffusion measurements, the predictors share an experimental provenance with the target — exactly the circularity Constitution VII forbids. The spec must require documenting that each proxy correlation is independent of D measurements, not merely assume 'sufficiently accurate.'

Bootstrap of feature-importance rankings is underspecified: it must state whether models are REFIT on each bootstrap resample (assessing ranking stability under data perturbation) or only predictions resampled. Resampling residuals/importances of a single fitted model does not assess stability against data perturbation and would make SC-002 near-tautological.
